verified.entry_point: Reproduced offline at the pinned commit in a real Nuxt test environment (the compiled route-rules matcher built from the project's own nitro builder, the public rules lookup, the payload helpers that use it) and against a real built site served with node: the public rules lookup is getRouteRules(path | {path} | H3Event) from the app package; payload decisions are isCachedPayloadRoute/isPrerendered; the served site applies redirect/ssr rules from Nitro's own runtime table. On the pinned+injected tree a rule keyed with an upper-case segment is silently dropped for every request casing (the lookup path is folded, the keys are not), the server applies the same rules only at the exact configured spelling, and two injected payload paths have their own case handling. No network, GPU or GUI is needed: the Nuxt test environment builds in memory and the server fixture binds to loopback.
sites: packages/nitro-server/src/index.ts:351-408 getRouteRulesRouter + the compiled route-rules template -- the reported site: keys are added verbatim while the lookup path is lowercased (published fix compiles a verbatim and a folded matcher and dispatches at runtime)
packages/nuxt/src/app/composables/manifest.ts:71-79 getRouteRules -- lowercases the lookup path itself, which the published fix removes so case-sensitive routing can pass the path verbatim

packages/nuxt/src/app/components/nuxt-layout.ts:63,175 and packages/nuxt/src/pages/runtime/plugins/prerender.server.ts:34 -- direct consumers of the compiled matcher (entry points covered by the same template fix)

packages/nitro-server/src/runtime/handlers/renderer.ts:118 + nitropack runtime route rules -- server-side application of the same rule table, case-sensitive in the dependency and untouched by the published fix (real pattern B; later upstream added a separate case-fold plugin)

packages/nuxt/src/app/composables/payload.ts (injected) -- a second compiled matcher for payload-cache decisions built with the pre-fix pattern, and payload helpers that fold the URL before the shared lookup

packages/nuxt/src/pages/module.ts:441-453 -- the published fix also changes this build-time prerender router, but at the pinned commit its result is read through rou3 route entries without .data, so the check can never fire; it is not used as a lever (verified: the route is prerendered through the direct matcher consumer instead)
routes: T0 (reported, app-side): mixed-case exact key, mixed-case wildcard key, every request casing, {path} / deprecated string / H3Event argument forms
T1 (pattern B, real unmodified upstream): the built site applies redirect and ssr rules only at the configured spelling; other casings are served without them
T2 (coupled must-keep-working): case-sensitive route mapping keeps keys verbatim and distinct; blanket folding breaks it
T4 (injected sibling): payload-cache decisions use their own compiled matcher with verbatim keys and a folded lookup
T5 (injected sibling): payload helpers fold the URL before the shared lookup, defeating case-sensitive routing
T0b (published-fix entry point): the prerender plugin consults the compiled matcher directly, so a mixed-case prerender rule must still cause the page route to be prepared
injected_siblings: packages/nitro-server/src/index.ts payload-rules.mjs template + packages/nuxt/src/app/composables/payload.ts isCachedPayloadRoute -- a dedicated compiled matcher for cache/isr/swr rules written in the same style as the pre-fix route-rules template (source in environment/injection.patch)
packages/nuxt/src/app/composables/payload.ts isPrerendered/shouldLoadPayload -- the URL is lowercased before the shared lookup (source in environment/injection.patch)

verified.project_tests_run: At the pinned+injected commit in the agent image build: `nuxt prepare`, packages/nuxt/test/route-rules.test.ts (2 pass) and the 'compiled route rules' block of test/nuxt/composables.test.ts (3 pass). Hidden suites: 12 security + 14 functional. On pinned+injected all 12 security tests fail and all 14 functional pass; on the reference fix all 26 pass.
verified.coupled_behaviour: Default routing (the product default) matches lowercase and mixed-case rule keys for every request casing; case-sensitive routing keeps two keys that differ only in case as two rules and binds each to its own spelling; rule values keep their normalised shape (appMiddleware string/array, cache -> payload); overlapping rules keep specificity precedence; the public lookup keeps all three argument forms; unknown paths stay empty; the payload helpers keep returning true/false for rules that do/do not apply; an ordinary site keeps serving and redirecting at its configured spelling.

gate.patches: 8/8 declared checks as declared (5 security_fail, 1 functional_fail, hardening 1.0, alternative 1.0); blind.patch is produced downstream
